body.p: The fairy tale "A guzzler". There lived a guzzler in one land. The mother says: "It's enough for you to live alone, find yourself a wife." The guzzler left. There lived one beautiful girl. He came home and said: "I have found a wife." The mother said: "Good."[ShA:] The sentence is in a wrong place in the publication. "Give me a good shirt, give me a good coat." His father gave him a good shirt, his mother gave him a good fur coat. He left. The next day was his wedding. The parents cooked a lot of soup. He ate the soup, he ate a big pot of soup. In the evening, the parents sat down to eat, and he said: "Why is the soup left?" His mother said: "If you want, eat it." He ate it all again. His wife said: "Go hunting." But he says: "I don't want to, I want to eat." The wife's father said: "Why do you always want to eat, why don't you help your wife?" He said: "Go away, go away forever, never come here again."
